# Task ID: 7
# Title: Extend Fortran Code for Simplified Materials
# Status: pending
# Dependencies: 6, 2
# Priority: high
# Description: Modify ModelDescription.F90 & Types.F90 so ElmerSolver understands new `MaterialLibrary` keyword generated by UI.
# Details:
• In Types.F90: extend `Material_t` to include `hasSimplifiedId` logical & `libId` integer.
• In ModelDescription.F90 (ReadMaterial):
   IF (Keyword == 'MaterialLibrary') THEN
       CALL LoadSimplifiedMaterial(libId,Mat)
   END IF
• Implement `LoadSimplifiedMaterial` in new Fortran module MaterialLib.F90 reading /usr/src/elmerfem/work/materials.json (use Fortran 2008 intrinsic ISO_FORTRAN_ENV + simple JSON parser e.g. FSON).
• Re-compile inside Dockerfile (add `git clone https://github.com/juntsang/FSON` && make install).


# Test Strategy:
Inside elmer container run case with `MaterialLibrary = 1` ; solver log shows correct properties. Add regression test: compare computed density to expected from materials.json.
